title: 一键标点
description: A mod that enables quick annotation and transmission.
body:
This mod was created to realize an idea I mentioned while chatting with friends:
Most PvP games feature a marking function. If we implemented such a mod in Minecraft—
one-click marking combined with Minecraft's unique feature (using the TP command for instant teleportation)—it would be truly awesome.
Currently, this mod is only compatible with the NeoForge version 1.21.x used on our server. We plan to add support for more versions based on feedback.



![Sending the coordinates](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/307fbcde474bf6150cd2f493fc4fbd88e9a9b2c3.png)

![You can change the punctuation keys](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e80d4752fd297a795f022ae5ab4e42a78b57d396_0.webp)

这个模组只是为了实现之前在和朋友聊天的时候提到的一个想法：
大部分PVP游戏都会有一个标点的功能，如果我们在我的世界中也做一个这样的模组
一键标点，再加入mc的特色（点击使用tp指令一键传送）那么这个模组一定很棒。
由于目前我们只是为了目前所使用服务器兼容而制作的模组，因此目前只有1.21.x的neoforge版本支持，后续会根据反馈增加更多版本的支持。
